content.intro: This lesson covers Static Analysis with Clippy. It sits in Module 27, Professional Rust Tooling and Team Workflows, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Static Analysis with Clippy matters when you work with repeatable quality checks and feedback. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.

content_blocks.text: Do not assume Static Analysis with Clippy guarantees more than it actually does. Reduce a failure to a small reproducer, read the full compiler diagnostic or error value, consult the matching official reference, and change one assumption at a time.
